steps.name: alpine/git@sha256:1e9d9a40acbd02aeb3cb005ff43f9e51ac09ba0c241bb2298f811d3f426a2ffd
args:
set -eu
test "$$EXPECTED_COMMIT_SHA" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
test "$${#EXPECTED_COMMIT_SHA}" -eq 40
case "$$EXPECTED_COMMIT_SHA" in *[!0-9a-f]*) echo "COMMIT_SHA must be a lowercase 40-character Git SHA." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
case "$$PLAYWRIGHT_SUITE" in smoke|full) ;; *) echo "_PLAYWRIGHT_SUITE must be exactly smoke or full." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
git --version
git rev-parse --verify "$$EXPECTED_COMMIT_SHA^{commit}" >/dev/null
actual_sha="$$(git rev-parse HEAD^{commit})"
test "$$actual_sha" = "$$EXPECTED_COMMIT_SHA"
printf 'Verified Cloud Build workspace revision %s for suite %s\n' "$$actual_sha" "$$PLAYWRIGHT_SUITE"
